# DonMap

The map layer of the Don addons for World of Warcraft: Forever and Classic Era: pins on the world map and the minimap, arrow and compass. Used by Guildon and Questdon.
Download: https://www.curseforge.com/projects/1774431

The full description (German) is in [README.md](../README.md). Bug reports are welcome as issues,
please add the text of `/donmap diag`.
